## CAD sheet sanity check (READ ONLY)

Looks only at the sheet (no Shopify call, no write). For the tabs listed in Config, it reads Product No., IMAGE URL11 (CAD drawing in the gallery), CAD Drawing URL (download button) and the size columns, then flags products whose CAD looks wrong:

- `file_name_other_product`: the CAD file name has a different product number than the row.
- `same_drawing_on_other_category`: the same drawing is used in another tab.
- `size_differs_from_group`: products sharing one drawing have clearly different sizes (more than 1.5 inch or 5%). Only when length, width and height are all known.
- `download_button_differs`: the download button file is not the gallery drawing.

Also counts products whose download button is empty, and lists the drawings used by more than one product so one drawing can be checked once for all its products.

It cannot see whether the drawing's shape matches the photo: a person still checks the flagged and grouped ones.

Config `sheets`: comma list of tabs (blank = all tabs).
